title: The Phantom of the Opera (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Anastasia, 18 years old, full of hopes and dreams, just moved to Paris to become a ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier. The artistic director, James Figueras, is reviving Orpheus, the mythic opera by Ernest Dupré, known as The Phantom of the Opera. One night, Anastasia meets the phantom. Together they embark on an impossible love story. Meanwhile, the prima ballerina meant for the role of Eurydice barely escapes death: the curse continues. Soon, Anastasia lands the prestigious role...
cast: Deva Cassel, Romain Duris, Julien de Saint-Jean, Dorothée Gilbert
